correctness.rationale: PASS: For the explicitly defined cubic bipartite GP(12,5), every perfect matching is generated uniquely by recursion pairing the least unmatched vertex; independently reproduced the 120 matchings. Their symmetric difference is a union of alternating even cycles and a one-cycle difference of exact length l is necessary and sufficient for an l-flip. Independently enumerated all 7140 unordered matching pairs and classified one-cycle differences: 4-flip graph has zero edges, 6-flip has 192 edges and component sizes 9×1,3×18,1×57, 8-flip has 414 edges and one 120-state component. BFS from all 120 matching states gives eccentricities 72×4,42×5,6×6, hence radius4 diameter6. Enumeration is exhaustive at the stipulated finite graph rather than sampled, and the pair-first implementation is logically different from the source's cycle-first verifier.

Bonamy et al. study quadrilateral flips; Nauru has girth six, so that graph is edgeless.
